name: bot-staff
description: Audits a set of scheduled agent routines and designs or redesigns them as a staff of single-job bots: a job sheet per bot, one shared record, an owner's yes before anything goes outside, direct handoffs, a chief-of-staff router, a weekly stand-up and build gates (scope cut, skeptic, QA, merge card). Use when asked to audit my bots or routines, design an agent team, redesign a bot setup, or write a bot job description.
